lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hey Reginald, Camila here. How's your Wednesday going?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hi! Yes, now's good.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Here's what I had in mind for today, but tell me if you'd rather focus on something else.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Actually, I had a question about my blood work.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How's your body feeling this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Honestly, rough week. I haven't been sleeping.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: That sounds like a hard week.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Did you hit your goal this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Some days yes, some days no. Maybe 1.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Would it be okay if I shared something that's helped other people?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Cooking a big pot on Sunday can cover two or three dinners.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: If I plan it the night before, I can do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Good for you for planning ahead.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I got home late every day this week.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You have to stop eating out so much.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't really see the point.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're not sure it's worth it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: That's real progress.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you cook on Sundays?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is your daughter able to help?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes. Vegetables are so expensive right now.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What could you try instead?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can probably manage three days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Part of you is already moving, and you want to keep that going.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I feel better about myself when I stick to it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Whatever you pick is fine with me. It's your plan.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so. I made a big pot of lentils on Sunday.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would your family say about these changes?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hmm, I have to think about that.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What could you try instead?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can cook on Sunday and have it for a few days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've got a plan in mind already.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Getting back to work is why I'm doing this.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You want to be around and be well for the people you love.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You'd rather start small and actually stick with it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I know I can do it, I did it before.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Once you decide something, you follow through.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I'd like to be able to keep up with my grandkids.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You want your energy back.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay, this week I'll really do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: This is about more than the cooking at home. It's about getting your life back.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I mean, I need this for my head too, not just my body.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What feels doable for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll try to cook at home 5 nights.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: 8. Maybe 9.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If the cost gets in the way again, what's your backup plan?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll ask my son to come with me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Let me make sure I got it. This week you did it 1 out of 4 days, the hard part was being so tired, and next week you're going to cook at home 5 nights. Did I miss anything?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, and I'll really try this time.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I'll text you midweek to see how it's going, and we'll talk again in two weeks.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Talk soon!

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thank you, Camila. Bye!

tags.note: Poor sleep and rough week reported
Feels better when sticking to plan
Wants to keep up with grandkids
Needs this for mental health too
Summary omits cost and sleep concerns

flags.reason: Directive 'You have to stop eating out' without permission; provoked sustain talk at line 18 and was not revisited.
Participant's blood work question was never answered or referred to a clinician.
Poor sleep and rough week reported; coach did not explore fatigue or its effect on the plan beyond a brief reflection.

score.summary: Camila built good momentum with autonomy-supporting language and drew out strong change talk, including a concrete 5-night cooking goal with a backup plan. However, she directed the participant to stop eating out at line 17, left the blood work question unaddressed, and did not explore the sleep problems.
strengths: Line 14 and line 53: repeatedly affirmed the participant's knowledge of their own schedule.
Line 29 and line 48: complex reflections captured ambivalence and the desire for energy back.
Line 59: asked an open question about a backup plan for cost barriers, eliciting the son as support.
coaching_tips: Line 17: replace the directive with a question such as 'Would it be useful to talk about eating out, or would you rather focus elsewhere?'
Line 4: acknowledge the blood work question and offer to route it to the care team before moving on.
Line 6: explore the poor sleep with an open question before setting goals, since fatigue is a barrier you named at line 16.
Line 61: include the cost concern from line 26 and the sleep issue in the summary to show full listening.
